groups.name: Batch
groups.description: Performs multiple create, update, delete, or query operations on QuickBooks Online entities in a single request to reduce network roundtrips and improve throughput.

groups.name: ChangeDataCapture
groups.description: The change data capture (cdc) operation returns a list of objects that have changed since a specified date-time, enabling an app to periodically poll data services and refresh its local copy of object data with a look-back time of up to 30 days.

operations.name: Get a list of changed entities

groups.name: Entitlements
groups.description: Retrieves the features available to a company, identified by the company's realmID. The available features are determined by the type of company established during QuickBooks Online setup, and represent a superset of those enabled for the company by preferences and for a user by permissions.

groups.name: Exchangerate
groups.description: Applicable only for those companies that enable multicurrency, the exchangerate resource provides the ability to query and set exchange rates available to the QuickBooks Online company. This entity works in combination with the companycurrency entity and the Currency Center in the QuickBooks Online UI to manage exchange rates for the company.

operations.name: Get an exchangerate for an individual currency code.

groups.name: RecurringTransaction
groups.description: Schedules the creation of transactions, sets up reminders, and creates reusable transaction templates in QuickBooks Online Essentials and Plus.

groups.name: TaxService
groups.description: Creates a new TaxCode object (with associated existing or dynamically-created TaxRate objects) in QuickBooks Online.
